import json, os, sys
from pathlib import Path
result=[]
for pid in json.loads(sys.argv[1]):
    p=Path('/proc')/str(pid)
    try:
        comm=(p/'comm').read_text().strip()
        args=[s.decode(errors='replace') for s in (p/'cmdline').read_bytes().split(b'\0') if s]
        exe=os.readlink(p/'exe')
        refs=[exe,os.readlink(p/'cwd')]
        for fd in (p/'fd').iterdir():
            try: refs.append(os.readlink(fd))
            except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError): pass
        entry=''
        if comm.startswith('python'):
            pos=1
            while pos<len(args) and args[pos] in ('-B','-I','-u','-E','-s','-S'): pos+=1
            if pos<len(args): entry=args[pos]
        named=comm in ('cargo','rustc','clippy-driver','perf','chrome','chromium','firefox','headless_shell')
        numeric=any(s in Path(entry).name for s in ('worker','numeric','analysis_ci','statistics','finite-driver','generate_dataset','qualification'))
        payload='/workspaces/quoridor' in exe and any(s in exe for s in ('/private/','/target/'))
        target=sys.argv[2]
        result.append({'pid':pid,'WT_reference':any(s==target or s.startswith(target+'/') for s in refs),'competitor':named or numeric or payload})
    except (FileNotFoundError,ProcessLookupError): result.append({'pid':pid,'absent':True})
print(json.dumps(result))
